name: Clown
storyline:
Clown is a psychological horror experience set
in a small neighborhood. You move into the
house you inherited after your grandmother's
death. As you go about your daily life, you
begin to notice that something is wrong in the
neighborhood. A clown appears in the garden.
When you check, it disappears. It enters your
dreams at night. A man from the neighborhood
knocks on your door and tells you the truth:

There is something here. And now it has
noticed you. The choice you make leads to two
different endings.
summary:
His laughter still echoes in my ears.

Nothing will ever be the same again...
